group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: Marie Curie in colour, in a Tokyo café

turns.text: Colourise this photo of Marie Curie, then show her in that same outfit sitting at a café window with a cup of tea, the Tokyo Tower from the second photo visible through the window behind her.

tests: A chain: colorize, then compose with a place reference; does it chain two tools or do both in one edit?

answer_sheet.Who: Marie Curie from the first photo, in colour, same outfit.
answer_sheet.Where: A café window with the Tokyo Tower behind.
answer_sheet.Doing: Sitting with a cup of tea.

must_haves: The woman's face matches the attached Curie photo (the drawn face, the hair pulled back).
She wears the same dark outfit with the patterned collar, now in colour.
The red-and-white Tokyo Tower is visible through the window behind her.
She sits at a café table with a cup of tea; the picture is in colour.
